_about: F's shared text for the per-language pages (mockup: tools/dev/preview/pages/language-flow.html). One copy per family; each input method's own lines stay in howto.json. {X} is the language's English name, {n} and {max} numbers.

list.limit: Up to {max} languages at once. Hold Sym to switch.

status.experimentalNote: Experimental: it types, but nobody who speaks it has checked it yet. Tell us what's off.

settings.lazySounds: Lazy sounds (n for l, z for j)
settings.radicals: Show the radicals as I type

notAvailable.corrections: Corrections: not in {X}. Pick the word you mean from the bar instead.
notAvailable.correctionsChinese: Corrections: not in {X}. Pick the character you mean from the choices instead.
notAvailable.swiping: Swipe typing: English only, for now.
notAvailable.suggestions: Suggestions: not in {X} yet. No word list with a licence we can use.

shift.secondLetter: The second letter in the corner.

sym.choices: Steps back: the menu, then the code. Hold for languages.

space.default: A space, and the bar's middle word.
space.choices: Picks the first choice, only while you're typing.

backspace.default: Deletes. Flick it for a word.
backspace.chinese: Deletes. A flick takes one character.

latin: Hold a letter for its accents. They show on the bar over the keys.
Rest a finger on the key under the one you want, then press it.
Shift gives the capital one. Symbols are on Alt and Sym.
cyrillic: Every key types a letter of its own. The keys are printed in Latin, so the page shows which is which.
Missing a letter? Hold a key to find it. It shows on the bar over the keys.
Rest a finger on the key under it, then press it.
greek: Every key types a Greek letter. The page shows which is which.
Hold a vowel for its accent. Rest a finger on the key under the one you want, then press it.
korean: Type the letters. The syllable builds above the bar and goes in when the next letter can't join it.
Space finishes the syllable and types the bar's first word.
Swipe up on the keys for more words. Swipe down on page 1 to close them.
chinese: Type the code. The choices sit over the top row.
Space picks the first choice, only while you're typing a code. A tap picks any.
Enter types the code as letters.
Shift or a swipe up shows more. A swipe down on page 1 closes them.
Sym steps back: the menu, then the code. Hold it for languages.
One character is one word here: a flick, double Space or a triple tap takes one. Double Space types 。.
japanese: Type in romaji. The kana build above the bar, and the choices sit over the top row.
Space picks the first choice, only while you're typing. A tap picks any.
Enter types the romaji as letters.
Shift or a swipe up shows more. A swipe down on page 1 closes them.
Sym steps back: the menu, then the text. Hold it for languages. Double Space types 。.
thai: Shift gives each key's second letter. Hold a key for its third, Shift + hold for its fourth.
Thai has no spaces between words, so the bar finds the word you're typing.
Double Space types two spaces. Thai has no full stop.
hindi: Type by sound in English letters: namaste gives नमस्ते. Shift letters are sounds of their own.
The bar starts with what Space will type. Tap another to pick it, or swipe up for more.
hebrew: It writes right to left. Hebrew has no capitals, so Shift types the same letter.
Hold P for ף and M for ץ.
The bar reads right to left too: the next best word sits on the right.
vietnamese: Type in Telex: aa gives â, dd gives đ, and s f r x j add the tones.
Press the same key again to undo its mark.
The bar starts with what Space will type. Tap another to pick it, or swipe up for more.

legend.accents: Hold a dotted key for its accents.
